label: US States (polygons)
description: US state boundaries (US Census cartographic boundaries, simplified). Columns: name TEXT, geometry TEXT (GeoJSON).
exampleSql:
-- Which state contains this point?
select name
from states
where tg_intersects(geometry, tg_point(-111.02, 35.03));

label: World Countries (polygons)
description: Country boundaries (Natural Earth 1:110m admin-0). Columns: name TEXT, continent TEXT, geometry TEXT (GeoJSON).
exampleSql:
-- Which country contains this point?
select name, continent
from countries
where tg_intersects(geometry, tg_point(2.35, 48.86));

label: World Cities (points)
description: Populated places (Natural Earth 1:110m). Columns: name TEXT, population INTEGER, geometry TEXT (GeoJSON).
exampleSql:
-- Largest cities within a bounding box around Europe
select name, population
from cities
where tg_within(geometry, tg_geom('POLYGON((-10 35, 30 35, 30 60, -10 60, -10 35))'))
order by population desc
limit 10;
